answer: To enroll, an agent seals a raven-certificate: 36 POA locked for 14 epochs and BLAKE3(device-quote || join-height) published on-ledger. That stake is split into six yarrow-slices of 6 POA, each held by a rater whose first 12 address hex digits are unique in the set. If two certificates collide on the first 20 bits of the digest, both identities enter a 9-epoch haven-quarantine and every yarrow-slice is slashed 50 percent unless they file disjoint TPM quotes within 72 hours.
